description: Withdraw USDC or USDT from the balance to one of the account's saved (CONFIRMED) addresses on Base; any other address is refused (403) and nothing moves. amount_micro is an integer string ("1000000" = 1 USDC): what leaves the balance, at most the withdrawable balance and at least the minimum (5 USDC by default). A flat fee (0.5 USDC by default) is kept from it when it settles; the answer gives fee_micro and receive_micro. Returns withdrawal_id and state INTENT; it is paid automatically once checks pass. Write tool: refused unless the server was started with AMPLERUN_MCP_ALLOW_SPEND=1 (the default is read-only).

idempotency_key.description: UUID that makes retries safe. Generated when omitted.

name: withdraw
title: Withdraw to a saved address
